_comment: Canonical OperatorUsage document shape. client is the authority - it tracks per-Operator resource usage for billing, quotas, and capacity planning. A field mismatch breaks usage reporting and quota enforcement.

operator_usage._description: Per-Operator resource usage record. Updated periodically from heartbeat telemetry. Used for billing, quota enforcement, and capacity planning.

id.description: Document ID. Composite of {operator_id}:{period} or just {operator_id} for rolling totals.

operator_id.description: Operator document ID this usage record tracks.

organization_id.description: Organization ID for multi-tenant usage aggregation.

cpu_seconds.description: Total CPU seconds consumed in the billing period.

memory_mb_hours.description: Total memory MB-hours consumed in the billing period.

execution_count.description: Number of command executions in the billing period.

ingress_bytes.description: Total ingress bytes in the billing period.

egress_bytes.description: Total egress bytes in the billing period.

active_sessions.description: Number of active sessions at the end of the billing period.

session_hours.description: Total session-hours in the billing period.

period_start.description: Start of the billing period this usage record covers.

period_end.description: End of the billing period this usage record covers.
